# Reconciliation of the frozen-T50 figures (generated by `research/reconcile.py`)

Every number is recomputed from the stored data and code and checked against the published results files. No published result was edited. Sources: `docs/research/ml_round1_results.json` (Round 1), `round2_results.json` (Round 2), `03_t50_scrutiny.md` (BNB).

## 1. Reproduction checks
- +251.2R baseline: recomputed 289 trades, +251.20R; published 289 trades, +251.20R → **match**.
- Single-account cells (main 9 / holdout 16, 2019–24, R0 and R3 = X1): all match.

## 2. The figures in question

| figure | what it is | universe, period | engine / account | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| +251.2R (289 trades) | frozen T50 total R, **every signal traded** | 25 coins, entries 2021-01-01 → 2024-12-31 | per-coin engine, one independent account per coin, no cross-coin limits | `ml_round1_results.json` base_G0 |

| BNB 38% of account | one BNB position in the **per-coin** BNB account (1,005 USDT) at its 2021-05-03 peak | BNB only, 2020-12 → 2021-05 | per-coin engine | `03_t50_scrutiny.md` line 254 |
| holdout DD 11.4% → 9.7% | R0 → R3, no halt | holdout 16, 2019–24 | single account | risk_variants rows 12, 15 |

**Execution assumptions, identical everywhere:** daily decisions at the close, fills at the next open; fee 0.20% per side, slippage 0.05%, stop slippage 0.20%; T50 stop 3 × ATR14 below the fill, fixed; exit on a 25-day-low close. Per-coin engine: 1,000 USDT per coin, 0.5% risk, 10% position cap, open position closed at the period end. Single account: 10,000 USDT, 0.5% risk, 10% position cap and 30% exposure at entry, 3 positions, 3% daily-loss stop, 10% drawdown kill switch (permanent) or no halt; coins that signal on the same day are taken in fixed universe order.

## 3. Signal level versus single account, by split

Signal level counts every T50 signal as its own trade. The single account can hold at most 3 positions and 30% exposure, so most signals are never taken. R per position in the book = position P&L ÷ its initial risk.

## 4. T50 single-account risk (frozen R0 book; X1 for comparison)

Open risk to stops = loss if every open stop filled at its stop price on the same day (simultaneous stop-outs). Gap 30% = instant loss if every coin held gapped down 30% (stops do not help). Correlation exposure = √(w′Pw) with the 90-day correlation of the coins held.
